heading: INT. FIELD BAKERY IN A RUINED CATHEDRAL - NIGHT, 1944

units.text: INT. FIELD BAKERY IN A RUINED CATHEDRAL - NIGHT, 1944
Ovens burn where the altar once stood.
Stained glass lies in colored shards along the nave.
Flour sacks form a low wall.
Distant artillery thumps like a slow heart.
SERGEANT ELIAS MWANGI, forties, sleeves rolled, kneads dough on a pew.
CORPORAL TADEUSZ BIELSKI, twenties, sits against a pillar rubbing his boot.
PRIVATE LACHLAN MUIR, nineteen, feeds wood into an oven.
LIEUTENANT HARUKO TANAKA, thirties, a quartermaster with a notebook, stands at the door reading a list by candlelight.
He lifts the dough, slaps it down.
She turns a page.
The private fans the fire with his cap.
Eleven hundred loaves by dawn. Sergeant Mwangi, will that be possible?
units.name: HARUKO

units.text: Possible, ma'am. Pleasant, no.
units.name: ELIAS

units.text: Sergeant, the flour is damp.
units.name: TADEUSZ

units.text: Flour is always damp in this country. Everything is.
units.name: ELIAS

units.text: Sergeant, do you think the cathedral minds?
units.name: LACHLAN

units.text: Minds what?
units.name: ELIAS

units.text: Us. Baking in it.
units.name: LACHLAN

units.text: Private, it's the warmest room for fifty miles. If God wanted it empty He should've kept the roof on.
units.name: ELIAS

units.text: My grandmother would have crossed herself.
units.name: TADEUSZ

units.text: Mine would have asked for the recipe.
units.name: HARUKO

units.text: What did she bake?
units.name: LACHLAN

units.text: Rice cakes. Very patiently. She said bread was for people in a hurry.
units.name: HARUKO

units.text: She was right.
units.name: ELIAS

units.text: Then what are we doing?
units.name: TADEUSZ

units.text: Hurrying. Badly.
units.name: ELIAS

units.text: A shell lands somewhere far off.
Dust sifts from the vault.
Nobody looks up.
Lieutenant, do you ever write home?
units.name: LACHLAN

units.text: Every Sunday.
units.name: HARUKO

units.text: What do you say?
units.name: LACHLAN

units.text: That the bread is excellent.
units.name: HARUKO

units.text: It is.
units.name: ELIAS

units.text: It is not. It is edible.
units.name: TADEUSZ

units.text: Edible is excellent, Corporal. Ask anyone who's been hungry.
units.name: ELIAS

units.text: Tadeusz nods slowly.
Lachlan adds a log.
The fire pops.
Haruko tears out a page, folds it, and slips it into her pocket.
Gentlemen, what time is it?
units.name: HARUKO

units.text: Nearly three.
units.name: ELIAS

units.text: Then you have two hours to make a thousand loaves.
units.name: HARUKO

units.text: And what will you do, ma'am?
units.name: ELIAS

units.text: Pray the bread is excellent.
units.name: HARUKO
